limit.description: Maximum number of non-pinned thread summaries to return. Pinned threads are always returned in full.

hostId.description: Optional host id returned by create_thread or list_threads.

turnLimit.description: Maximum number of turns to return.

includeOutputs.description: Whether to include truncated tool or command outputs.

maxOutputCharsPerItem.description: Maximum characters to keep for each included Codex output or chat message.

targets.description: Threads to wait for. The first target that completes or needs attention wins.

hostId.description: Optional host id returned by create_thread or list_threads.

afterCursor.description: Optional cursor returned by an earlier wait.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum event-wait time in milliseconds. A bounded snapshot fetch for fresh progress may add latency. Defaults to 120000.

hostId.description: Optional host id returned by create_thread or list_threads.

model.description: Optional model override. Models and supported reasoning efforts on the calling host: gpt-6-astra (Frontier intelligence for the most demanding work.; supported reasoning efforts: low, medium, high, xhigh, max, ultra), gpt-6-sol (Workhorse model for coding and everyday work.; supported reasoning efforts: low, medium, high, xhigh, max, ultra), gpt-6-luna (Fast and affordable model for easier tasks.; supported reasoning efforts: low, medium, high, xhigh, max), gpt-5.6-sol (Older coding model for complex work.; supported reasoning efforts: low, medium, high, xhigh, max, ultra), gpt-5.6-terra (Older balanced model for straightforward work.; supported reasoning efforts: low, medium, high, xhigh, max, ultra), gpt-5.6-luna (Older fast and efficient model.; supported reasoning efforts: low, medium, high, xhigh, max), gpt-5.5 (Legacy coding model.; supported reasoning efforts: low, medium, high, xhigh).

thinking.description: Optional reasoning effort override. Must be supported by the selected model.
